content.title: Clemson basketball falls to Iowa, Bennett Stirtz in March Madness first round
content.text: Updated March 20, 2026, 9:34 p.m. ETTAMPA, FL — Clemson basketball’s run in the Men’s NCAA Tournament is over.No. 9 seed Iowa beat No. 8 Clemson 67-61 in the first round on March 20 at Benchmark International Arena.The Hawkeyes (22-12) will face either No. 1 seed Florida or No. 16 Prairie View in the second round on March 22.Clemson (24-11) cut its deficit to four points with 1:28 remaining, but Iowa's Kael Combs made a contested layup to stave off the Tigers.For the second straight season, Clemson had a slow start in March Madness. The Tigers trailed by double digits early in the first half. Clemson responded, cutting its deficit to two points around the 14-minute mark in the second half.Yet, Iowa kept going on runs to prevent Clemson from overtaking the Hawkeyes. Iowa’s largest lead was 14 points as Clemson never led against the Hawkeyes.RJ Godfrey led Clemson in scoring with 15 points. Butta Johnson added 11.Bennett Stirtz led all scorers with 16 points, and Combs had 14 for Iowa to advance.Watch Clemson basketball vs Iowa in March Madness on SLING TV (subscribe today)Clemson vs Iowa score updates Final: Iowa 67, Clemson 61 Clemson vs Iowa highlights Bennett Stirtz stats for Iowa vs Clemson in March MadnessHere's how Iowa's star player performed against Clemson:Points: 16Rebounds: 5Assists: 2Steals: 2Blocks: 0Turnovers: 1Field-goal percentage: 4 of 17 (23.5%)3-point percentage: 3 of 10 (30%)Free-throw percentage: 5 of 6 (83.3%)Fouls: 0+/-: 6Minutes: 40 3:47 in game: Iowa 57, Clemson 51Clemson trails by six after fighting to reduce its deficit to single digits. 7:36 in game: Iowa 51, Clemson 40Iowa had its largest lead of 14 points, but Clemson's Jestin Porter made a 3-pointer to cut it to 11.That was Clemson's first three in the second half after missing its first seven.Iowa's Tate Sage and Alvaro Folgueiras have combined for 13 points in the second half. 11:57 in game: Iowa 42, Clemson 33Iowa extended its lead with a 7-0 run as Tate Sage made back-to-back layups.Iowa is also dominating Clemson in rebounds, having 30 rebounds (11 offensive) to Clemson's 21 (eight).The Hawkeyes have scored seven second-chance points to Clemson's zero. 13:48 in game: Iowa 38, Clemson 33Clemson cut its deficit to two points, but Iowa's Bennett Stirtz made a 3-pointer to extend Iowa's lead. 15:32 in game: Iowa 35, Clemson 31Clemson is on a 6-0 run to cut its deficit to four points. The Tigers' defense has held Iowa scoreless for 4:22 as the Hawkeyes have missed their last six attempts.RJ Godfrey's and-1 layup and Chase Thompson's contested layup has the Tigers nearing their first lead of the game. How have No. 8 seeds performed in March Madness this yearNo. 8 seeds are 0-3 in the Men's NCAA Tournament this season.No. 9 TCU beat No. 8 Ohio State in the East Region, No. 9 Utah State beat No. 8 Villanova in the West Region and No. 9 Saint Louis defeated No. 8 Georgia in the Midwest Region. Halftime: Iowa 32, Clemson 25Clemson cut its deficit to seven points at halftime. The Tigers' shooting improving, making five of their last six field goals to close the first half.Butta Johnson is Clemson's leading scorer with six points.Iowa made no field goals in the final 3:08 in the first half, but the Hawkeye made three free throws to remain in the lead.Kael Combs lead all scorers with 11 points. 3:44 in first half: Iowa 25, Clemson 16Clemson is finding its offensive footing, making three of its last four field-goal attempts. Six Tigers have scored against Iowa. Dabo Swinney in attendance to watch Clemson vs Iowa in March MadnessWith Clemson football on spring break, Tigers coach Dabo Swinney is in Tampa, Florida, to cheer on the Tigers' basketball team. 8:15 in first half: Iowa 22, Clemson 10Clemson called its first timeout as the Tigers cannot get their offense going.Clemson is shooting 4 of 19 from the field, including 1 of 6 from 3-point range. 11:32 in first half: Iowa 18, Clemson 8Iowa went on a 10-5 run to have a double-digit lead. The Hawkeyes' Bennett Stirtz has only three points as three other Iowa players have scored, including Kael Combs who has eight points.Clemson is shooting just 3 of 14 as only three players have scored baskets. The Tigers have never led so far. 15:49 in first half: Iowa 8, Clemson 3Iowa has a early lead after making three of it first four attempts, including two 3-pointers.Clemson is shooting 1-of-5, including 1-of-4 from 3-point range. RJ Godfrey drew a foul at the first media timeout. Why Clemson players are wearing No. 41 on jerseys in March Madness Clemson's No. 41 patch on its jerseys will make its debut in the Men's NCAA Tournament.Clemson started wearing the black patch with white numbers to honor former basketball star Elden Campbell, Clemson's all-time leading scorer who wore No. 41. The wins came against Mercer and Georgia Tech.Iowa:G Bennett StirtzG Kael CombsG/F Tavion BanksF Cam ManyawuF Cooper Koch Clemson vs Iowa betting odds Game lines and odds for Clemson vs. Iowa: Spread: Clemson (+1.5)Over/under: 130.5Moneyline: Clemson (+105), Iowa (-125) Clemson vs Iowa injury reportClemson will be without starting center Carter Welling, who tore his ACL against Wake Forest on March 11. He is the Tigers' second-leading scorer, top rebounder and best shot blocker. Freshman guard Zac Foster has been out with a torn ACL since December.Iowa has no notable injuries. Clemson vs Iowa series historyIowa is 3-1 all-time against Clemson.The Hawkeyes won the last meeting in 2022, winning 74-71 on Nov. 25 in the Emerald Coast Classic in Niceville, Florida. Clemson basketball's NCAA Tournament history under Brad BrownellThe Tigers have reached six NCAA tournaments in Brownell's 16 seasons with Clemson, including five bids in the past nine seasons.The Tigers' March Madness record is 6-5 under Brownell.The Tigers have 16 NCAA tournament appearances in program history. Clemson has made two Elite Eight appearances but has never been to a Final Four.Clemson is one of 19 teams since 2018 to make at least four NCAA tournaments and advance to at least two Sweet 16s (2018, 2024) and one Elite Eight (2024). Benchmark International Arena capacityBenchmark International Arena holds a maximum of 21,500 people. Who coaches IowaBen McCollum is in his first season as Iowa's coach. He has made the NCAA Tournament 13 times across Division I and II dating back to 2013-14 (excluding 2019-20 that was disrupted due to COVID-19). How long has Brad Brownell been at ClemsonBrad Brownell became Clemson's coach in 2010, replacing Oliver Purnell after seven seasons. Brownell received a two-year contract extension last season that runs through 2030-31.What time does Clemson vs Iowa start? Streaming options for the game include SLING TV.Clemson vs Iowa predictionDerrian Carter, The Greenville News — Clemson 68, Iowa 63: The Tigers will advance to the second round of March Madness in a closely contested game. Both teams won't build big leads against each other, but Clemson will go on second-half run to take down the Hawkeyes.HawkCentral, Des Moines Register — Iowa 72, Clemson 68: Clemson has looked good at times this season, but the Tigers also haven't proven that they're a team to be terribly scared of in the opening round of action, especially with Welling out with the torn ACL. It won't be a blowout either way, but the Hawkeyes are seemingly playing their best basketball of the season right now, and they should get past the Tigers to open up the NCAA Tournament.
